description: Full-featured modern media downloader web service powered by FastAPI, yt-dlp, and FFmpeg.

tech_stack.backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Uvicorn, yt-dlp, imageio-ffmpeg, WebSockets, aiofiles
tech_stack.frontend: Vanilla JS (ES6+), HTML5, Tailwind CSS CDN, Lucide Icons CDN, Custom Glassmorphism CSS
tech_stack.media_engine: FFmpeg 7.1 (located in bin/ffmpeg.exe or via imageio_ffmpeg)

main_functions: download_media_item(url, download_type, quality, output_format, video_codec, sub_lang, embed_subs, cookie_type, cookie_value, proxy, progress_callback)

critical_rules_for_agents: NEVER run uvicorn with watch on entire directory - ALWAYS use --reload-dir backend --reload-dir static to prevent WinError 32 file locking.
ALWAYS pass ffmpeg_location=get_ffmpeg_dir() to yt-dlp so it resolves bin/ffmpeg.exe on Windows.
ALWAYS keep windowsfilenames=True, overwrites=True, and updatetime=False in ydl_opts.
Do NOT add heavy node/npm dependencies - the frontend is pure HTML/CSS/JS served directly by FastAPI static files.
